feedback.problem: Consider the lamina that occupies the region $D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le \sqrt{y},\,0\le y\le 4}.$ Given that the area of the lamina is $\frac{16}{3}$ square units, find the $x$-coordinate of its centroid.
feedback.worked_solution:
The centroid of a lamina $D$ with area ${A}_{D}$ is given by $({x}_{c},{y}_{c}),$ where

$$
{x}_{c}=\frac{1}{{A}_{D}}{∬}_{D}x\,\,\text{d}A,\,{y}_{c}=\frac{1}{{A}_{D}}{∬}_{D}y\,\,\text{d}A.
$$

Therefore, the $x$-coordinate of the centroid is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{c} & =\frac{1}{{A}_{D}}{∬}_{D}x\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{3}{16}{\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{y}}x\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{16}{\int }_{0}^{4}{[\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{x=0}^{x=\sqrt{y}}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{16}{\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{y}{2}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{16}{[\frac{{y}^{2}}{4}]}_{0}^{4} \\  & =\frac{3}{16}\cdot 4 \\  & =\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
